---
title: "QA Output and Review Cycle"
editor: visual
---

This is the final stage of checking output and product.

A peer review check to ensure that the product provides insight and converys the information it is designed to in the best possible format.  Having fresh eyes on a report to ensure that any message or data is clear and not subject to misinterpretation. 

Linking the product back to the scope and ensuring that it provides the information or insight as specified within the initial scope. This includes accessibility of products, clarity of visualisations and quality of narrative.

At this stage the full Standard Operating Procedure should be complete and also form part of the final quality assurance.

Outputs should be saved to or linked from the appropriate section of the team NHS Future Page.

Code should be reviewed and saved within GitHub and all documentation completed. 

For ongoing work, the automation process should be documented and a review set for when the product should undergo review.
